text:
Valentina Marchetti has been a steady presence on our team, contributing reliably to projects that bridge adtech’s complex data needs with user-friendly interfaces. Her work on the campaign analytics dashboard stands out—she refactored legacy React components into a modular Next.js structure, which cut load times by 40% without sacrificing functionality. That attention to performance is consistent; she often flags opportunities to optimize resource usage, whether trimming unused Node.js processes or streamlining REST API calls.  

Her technical approach is methodical. When we needed to integrate real-time bid data, Valentina designed a GraphQL layer that simplified data fetching across frontend tools. She also spearheaded test automation with Playwright, reducing manual QA hours by roughly half. These solutions aren’t just functional—they’re maintained with clarity, making them easy to adapt as requirements evolve.  

Beyond code, Valentina’s collaborative spirit is a plus. She’s patient with junior engineers, explaining complex TypeScript type definitions or debugging tricky Selenium scripts without frustration. Her ability to distill technical jargon into actionable steps has helped align cross-functional teams around shared goals.  

Valentina’s reliability and curiosity make her a trusted teammate. She’s the kind of engineer who’ll quietly improve a workflow until it’s nearly invisible—yet deeply impactful. I’d welcome the chance to collaborate again.
